record_type_quote: The present study was performed on an independent sample of healthy male individuals.

targets.authors: Borg J, Andrée B, Soderstrom H, Farde L.
targets.title: The serotonin system and spiritual experiences.
targets.evidence_quote: The aim of the present study was to perform a replication of our previous study ( Borg et al., 2003 ) in a larger sample.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, we failed to replicate our previous finding of a negative association between ST/SA and 5-HT 1A receptor binding. Rather, our Bayesian analysis found more evidence for a lack of correlation.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure to replicate the prior association.
